meta.reviewed: Draft from extract_style.py, reviewed by hand: see rationale; the extraction log is style-extract.md.

source.notes: terse research-tool README: abstract with citations, install, usage, results table (demo data), method, BibTeX
docs site landing page (dark only): hero, Figure 1 block mask, results table, method steps
docs site theme: 12 colour tokens --sb-*, font tokens, @font-face for the shipped OFL fonts

rationale.palette: Dark theme: the docs site is dark only (color-scheme: dark, theme-color #0A0E17) [E3, E7, E17]. Every role is an authored token from docs/theme.css [E7]: bg --sb-bg #0A0E17, bg2 --sb-bg-subtle #0E1422, surface --sb-surface #131B2B, line --sb-border #22304A, ink --sb-text #E8EEF7, ink2 --sb-text-muted #9AA8BF, accent --sb-primary #2FE4F0 (the spark kernel), accent2 --sb-secondary #8B7CFF (block-sparse in the results table), accent3 --sb-tertiary #FFB547 (global blocks in Figure 1), ok/warn/deny --sb-success/--sb-warning/--sb-danger. muted is not a token: the draft's neutral #6C7079 was replaced by #6E7C94, the same blue-grey hue as ink2, at 4.57:1 on bg. Contrast on bg: ink 16.55:1, ink2 8.02:1, muted 4.57:1, accent 12.39:1. ok and deny are close for deutan viewers: the reel never signals by colour alone (▲ and words). paletteAlt is derived and unused (every scene is dark); its muted is lifted to 4.5:1 like every text role.
rationale.type: The docs page sets Space Grotesk for headings and body and JetBrains Mono for code [E4, E5, E6]; both ship in source/docs/fonts as variable OFL-1.1 files [E14, E15], so fonts.files embeds them (the draft listed the variable font's default instance name, Space Grotesk Light, as the display family; fixed to the family). Heading/body ratio 5.85 → modular step 1.38; displayWeight 700 as the docs' h1/h2; bodyWeight 400; headline tracking -0.015 em (the docs h1 uses -0.03 em at 76 px); labels tracked 0.142 em like the docs' mono kicker (0.18 em).
rationale.motion: Energy 0.43: no '!', emoji or marketing words, 129 numbers/1k and 7 citations/1k [E1] → medium pace, but the copy is calm and formal: the reel opens calm and builds to one impact (the 4.1× result). playful 0.00, technical 0.89, serious 0.50 → heavily damped spring (f 2.2, z 0.84), almost no overshoot (0.15), outExpo: precise, not bouncy. Transitions from the tone scores: glitch 0.74 (terminal tool on a dark stage), match 0.70, zoomInto 0.66, cut 0.41, impact 0.32 (numbers that land).
rationale.sound: dark-synth scored 0.80 (next ambient 0.43): dark 1, technical 0.89, data 0.78, playful 0 [E1, E7]. The draft's 123 BPM (inside 118–130 by energy) was nudged to 128 so 8 bars = 15.0 s and 16 bars = 30.0 s exactly (timing-and-length.md: 15 s is whole bars at multiples of 16 BPM). Key B from the accent hue 205° (free choice), minor (dark, cool, technical). drums light keeps the grooves sparse (kick on 1 and 3); the drop reaches energy 1.0, which switches to the full dark kit, so the reel builds to the impact; clap and snare are added to the instrument list for that drop. sfx digital (HUD, terminal, data).
rationale.narration: Recommended: a research-style README (abstract, 7 citations/1k, formal register, 711 words) with numeric claims that need their qualifier ('in the demo run') spoken [E1]. Voice Charon (informative), tag [confident, clear], en-US. The 15-s cut keeps two short lines; the 30-s cut narrates every scene. Captions are burned in (layout.captions) because a README preview plays muted.
rationale.visuals: No mascot or photo in the material (characters false). Carriers: vector data viz (dataViz true: 2 tables, Figure 1, data 0.78) and a REAL terminal capture of `spark-bench run` [E1] made with tools/capture_cli.py. The 4,096-block point cloud and the particle logo are computed from the README's pattern definition (band 7, 2 global blocks, 1,024-token blocks at 64k tokens). web-shots dropped: the reel does not show the docs page.
